_note: Wave 5b V3, helicopter supports (HeliSupports, HeliCall). Everything here is Proposed. Prices are in data/prices.json "supports" (Economy.server_pay_support). cooldown_s: after a call, how long before that support can be called again. resupply: the pallet's load (HeliSupports.resupply_load): per_weapon gives, for every weapon the squad carries (players and squad AI, primary and sidearm), its magazines ([mags, loose rounds of that calibre]); fixed lists the rest as [item id, count]; pallet is the item it all sits on.

resupply._note: Captain, 2026-10-16: enough for everyone, by role. per_weapon: mags and loose rounds for EACH soldier's weapon; per_head: for each soldier; per_role: extra for a soldier of that role; fixed: once.
